Container.Name: ARVIO-Web
Container.Overview: Preview of the independent ARVIO browser media hub. Connect your own supported media services and sources; no ARVIO subscription is required. Built-in movie and TV metadata requires your own TMDB API v3 key. Profiles, settings and history live in each browser, not in the container. This is a browser client, not a media server, transcoder or ARVIO Cloud sync service. No media or third-party subscriptions are included. Keep this installation private; internet access requires HTTPS and authentication protecting every route.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: arvio jellyfin plex emby media browser selfhosted

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port on your Unraid LAN. Do not forward this port to the internet; use HTTPS and an authenticated reverse proxy for remote access.

Config.Name: TMDB API v3 key
Config.Description: Your own TMDB API v3 key (32 hexadecimal characters), not the read-access bearer token. Required for built-in movie/show metadata. Kept server-side; never share this template with a saved key.

Config.Name: Allow private home-server proxy
Config.Description: Leave false unless this installation is private and authenticated. True allows server-side API requests to private Jellyfin/Plex/Emby addresses. Protect all API routes before enabling; never expose an unrestricted LAN proxy publicly.

Config.Name: Trakt application client ID
Config.Description: Optional: your own Trakt application's public client ID. Also set its server-only secret. Restart the container after changes.

Config.Name: Trakt application secret
Config.Description: Optional: your own Trakt application's secret; kept server-side. Do not enter a user access token or share filled templates.

Config.Name: Simkl application client ID
Config.Description: Optional: your own Simkl application's public client ID. Configure a secret for OAuth token exchange where required. Restart after changes.

Config.Name: Simkl application secret
Config.Description: Optional: your own Simkl application secret; kept server-side. Do not enter a user access token or share filled templates.

Config.Name: Telegram application ID
Config.Description: Optional: your own Telegram application ID, paired with its API hash. These application credentials are visible to your browser. Never enter a bot token, login code or session.

Config.Name: Telegram application API hash
Config.Description: Optional: your Telegram application's API hash, paired with its ID. This is browser-visible application configuration, not a login secret; mask only hides it in this form. Never enter passwords, tokens or sessions.

Config.Name: Independent resolver URL
Config.Description: Advanced and optional: HTTPS URL of your own compatible resolver, without URL credentials, query or fragment. The URL is browser-visible. Does not grant access to ARVIO-hosted services.
